records.notes: Visible forms show ٱلنَّبِيُّ or its alif presentation in most editions and اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ in Warsh/Qalun, a clear final hamza/letter-form difference.
Visible forms show يَكُن in Hafs/Shu'bah/Duri/Susi and تَكُن in Warsh/Qalun/Bazzi/Qunbul, a clear initial-letter difference.
Visible forms differ substantially in alif/wasla, hamza, and dagger-alif presentation around ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ; the evidence supports a form difference but not a confident semantic subtype.
Visible forms show يَكُن in Hafs/Shu'bah and تَكُن in the other editions, a clear initial-letter difference.
Visible forms show لِنَبِيٍّ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi and لِنَبِےٓءٍ in Warsh/Qalun, a clear final hamza/letter-form difference.
